nodes.label: Exact OU transition via Van Loan (1978) block-matrix exponential
nodes.norm_label: exact ou transition via van loan (1978) block-matrix exponential
nodes.rationale: OU SDE is linear so its transition is exactly Gaussian; one expm per interval shared across particles keeps cost low.

nodes.label: Tong et al. 2023, minibatch OT flow matching
nodes.norm_label: tong et al. 2023, minibatch ot flow matching

nodes.label: CMA-ES optimizer
nodes.rationale: Chosen for moderate-D, non-convex, gradient-free fitting; isotropic sigma0 cannot inherit the zero-step bug and adapted covariance replaces simplex geometry tracking. Budget-matched maxfevals=2200.

nodes.label: Custom initial simplex fix (_initial_simplex)
nodes.rationale: Gives zero coordinates the same ~0.06 absolute step as diagonal; edge_corr improved -0.02 -> +0.36.

nodes.label: Nelder-Mead plateau on 65-D landscape
nodes.rationale: 4x evaluation budget barely moved edge_corr (0.36->0.37); plateau, not starved budget.

nodes.label: Nelder-Mead zero-coordinate initial simplex bug (zdelt=0.00025)
nodes.rationale: scipy's default simplex gives zero-valued x0 coordinates a hardcoded 0.00025 step, so all 56 off-diagonal entries (zero in x0) barely moved; fitted A stayed diagonal-only.

nodes.label: Single-step Euler-Maruyama discretization bias
nodes.rationale: n_substeps sweep showed true-vs-fitted loss gap flips sign; single step inflated transition covariance ~5x.

nodes.label: NaN-guard: non-finite transition treated as rejected candidate
nodes.norm_label: nan-guard: non-finite transition treated as rejected candidate

nodes.label: JKOnet*-linear full per-dimension feature grid gotcha
nodes.norm_label: jkonet*-linear full per-dimension feature grid gotcha
nodes.rationale: RBF centers and polynomials use full product grids ((degree+1)^G features), causing hangs/OOM at 8 genes; driver disables RBF and uses degree 2.

nodes.label: Six loss combinations (OU, FP, OU+FP, OU+Cons, FP+Cons, OU+FP+Cons)
nodes.norm_label: six loss combinations (ou, fp, ou+fp, ou+cons, fp+cons, ou+fp+cons)
nodes.rationale: All 6 evaluated rather than one picked 'best', since a single past sweep ranking would be noise.

nodes.label: Covariance-trajectory moment preconditioner (estimate_theta0)
nodes.rationale: dSigma/dt = -A Sigma - Sigma A^T + sigma^2 I is linear in A and uses all gene pairs; mean-based attempts were rank-deficient under uniform perturbation. edge_corr ~0.41 at zero optimizer cost.

nodes.label: Failed mean-trajectory preconditioners (Euler and logm)
nodes.rationale: Uniform perturbation makes mean decay along one direction: rank-deficient regression; logm amplified noise (offdiag_err ~13.5).

nodes.label: Per-particle Kalman filter (rejected)
nodes.rationale: Would need per-cell correspondence across snapshots, which scRNA-seq lacks (cells destroyed); would leak information.

nodes.label: Non-interventional GRN recovery question (constant mu)
nodes.rationale: Knockout runs scored at chance; hypothesis that the intervention transient buries edge signal, so mu held constant.

nodes.label: CytoBridge (considered, rejected)
nodes.rationale: PyTorch-based (same vendoring problem) and no built-in fixed drift support.

nodes.label: Minibatch-OT conditional flow matching (ott-jax)
nodes.rationale: ott-jax chosen: already a dependency, JAX-native, no second venv, and cond is a first-class argument for feeding mu_k. Approximates Benamou-Brenier OT map, not a full stochastic SB.
